id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

effectiveDate.description: date that the holiday is in effect for the schedule, inclusive

effectiveEndDate.description: date that the holiday is no longer in effect for the schedule, exclusive

startTime.description:
time of the day for the associated holiday that is in effect for the schedule
i.e. hours of operation.  inclusive HH:MM - will change to time datatype

endTime.description:
time of the day for the associated holiday that is no longer in effect for the
schedule.  i.e. hours of operation.  exclusive.  null implies unbounded to end of the day
HH:MM - will change to time datatype

title:
The association of a holiday to a schedule plus a window of time
for reduced or extended hours for the related holiday
e.g. Holidays that apply to this schedule.
00:00 to 00:00 means no hours  00:00 to null means all 24 hours of the day
Business Key: schedule+scheduleHoliday+non overlapping effective dates
name: ScheduleHolidaySchedule
